description: Eight white noise sources, each giving a fresh random voltage on the rising edge of its own gate, or running as continuous noise while that gate is unpatched

params.text: Scales every output together, silence fully left and full level fully right; it is ignored entirely while anything is patched to CV

inputs.text: A rising edge above 2V draws one fresh random voltage for the Out jack on that row, which is then held until the next edge
Scales every output together in place of the Spread knob, 0V for silence and 10V for full level; past 10V the outputs are scaled beyond full, and a negative voltage inverts them

outputs.text: Gaussian white noise scaled by Spread; with the Gate jack on that row patched the voltage changes only on a gate edge, and with it unpatched the noise runs continuously

notes: patching anything into CV cuts the Spread knob out altogether: the knob is read only while CV is empty.
each output draws its own noise value, so no two outputs ever carry the same voltage.
the gate threshold is 2V rising, and the gate has to fall below 0.1V before it can fire again.
